q1.explanationZh: random 作形容词“随机的”，作名词常用于 at random“随机地”。

q2.explanationZh: range 动词“排列；（在一定范围内）变动”，名词“范围；一排”，range from A to B“从 A 到 B 不等”。

q3.explanationZh: rank 动词“排列；占特定等级”，名词“等级；军衔”，rank high“排名靠前”。

q4.explanationZh: rapid 形容词“快的，迅速的”，副词是 rapidly。

q5.explanationZh: rare 形容词“稀有的，罕见的”，副词 rarely 意为“很少”。

q6.explanationZh: rat“鼠”，一般指比 mouse 大的老鼠，like a drowned rat“像落水老鼠”。

q7.explanationZh: rate 名词“率，比率”，如 death rate“死亡率”。

q8.explanationZh: rather 副词“相当；宁可”，常见 rather than、would rather。

q9.explanationZh: rating 是 rate 的派生名词“等级，级别”。

q10.explanationZh: raw 形容词“生的；未加工的”，raw data“原始数据”。

q11.explanationZh: ray 名词“射线；光线”，the sun’s rays“阳光”。

q12.explanationZh: reach 及物动词“到达”，后面直接接地点，不用 to；名词表示“伸手可及的范围”。

q13.explanationZh: react 不及物动词“作出反应”，常用 react to sth.。

q14.explanationZh: reaction 是 react 的名词“反应；作用”。

q15.explanationZh: read“读”，过去式和过去分词拼写不变，仍是 read。

q17.explanationZh: readily 是 ready 的副词，y 变 i 加 -ly，“乐意地；迅速地”。

q19.explanationZh: ready 形容词“准备就绪的”，get ready for“为……做好准备”。

q20.explanationZh: real 形容词“真的，真正的”，名词是 reality。

q21.explanationZh: realistic 形容词“现实的；逼真的”，由 real 派生。

q22.explanationZh: reality 是 real 的名词“现实”，复数 realities。

q23.explanationZh: realise 是英式拼写，美式拼作 realize，意思都是“实现；意识到”。

q24.explanationZh: really 是 real 的副词“确实地；真正地”，注意双写 l。

q25.explanationZh: rear 名词“后部”，in the rear of“在……的后部”。

q26.explanationZh: reason 名词“理由，原因”，动词“推理”，the reason why ...“……的原因”。

q27.explanationZh: reasonable = reason + -able，“合理的；（价钱）公道的”。

q28.explanationZh: rebel 作名词重音在前 /ˈrebl/，作动词重音在后 /rɪˈbel/。

q29.explanationZh: rebuild = re-（再）+ build，“重建”，过去分词 rebuilt。

q30.explanationZh: recall 动词或名词“回忆；召回”，recall one’s childhood“回想童年”。

q31.explanationZh: receipt“收据，发票”，注意 p 不发音。

q32.explanationZh: receive“收到”，注意 ei 的拼写（c 后面写 ei）。

q33.explanationZh: received 形容词“被普遍接受的；公认的”。

q34.explanationZh: recent 形容词“新近的”，in recent years“近几年”。

q35.explanationZh: recently = recent + -ly，副词“近来，最近”，常与现在完成时连用。

q36.explanationZh: range 名词“排，行”，a range of“一排；一系列”。

q37.explanationZh: rather than 连接两个并列成分，表示“而不是”。

q38.explanationZh: would rather 后接动词原形：would rather do sth.。

accept: would rather do A than do B

q39.explanationZh: would rather do A than do B，than 前后都用动词原形。

q41.explanationZh: would rather (that) + 从句，从句用过去式表示虚拟，that 可省略。

q42.explanationZh: get ready for“为……做好准备”，ready 是形容词。

q43.explanationZh: reach 作名词“伸手可及的范围”，within one’s reach“在某人伸手可及之处”。

q44.explanationZh: reason 作动词“推理”，用副词 clearly 修饰。

q45.explanationZh: write out“开出（票据）”，receipt“发票，收据”。

q48.explanationZh: react 是不及物动词，后接介词 to：react to sth.。

q49.explanationZh: realise“实现”，realise one’s dream“实现某人的梦想”。

q50.explanationZh: rear 名词“后部”，the rear of ...“……的后部”。

q51.explanationZh: 修饰形容词 sleepy 用副词 rather“相当，有点”。

q52.explanationZh: 修饰名词 drug testing 用形容词 random“随机的”。

q53.explanationZh: range from A to B“在 A 到 B 之间变动”，主句讲过去的比赛，用过去式 ranged。

q54.explanationZh: within one’s reach“在某人伸手可及之处”，reach 作名词。

q55.explanationZh: was + 过去分词构成被动语态，rebuild 的过去分词是 rebuilt。

q56.explanationZh: rank high“排名靠前”，主语 prices 是复数，用原形 rank。

q57.explanationZh: the general reader“一般读者”，与 the student 对应，用单数名词 reader。

q58.explanationZh: 修饰名词 value 用形容词 real“真正的”。

q59.explanationZh: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形，realize your dream“实现梦想”。

q60.explanationZh: begin to do 后接动词原形，realise“意识到”，后接 how 引导的宾语从句。

q61.sampleAnswer: That bird is very rare in this country.
references: That bird is very rare in this country.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: 系动词 is 后接形容词 rare“罕见的”作表语。

q62.sampleAnswer: It is truly amazing that artificial intelligence has turned many impossibilities into realities.
references: It is truly amazing that artificial intelligence has turned many impossibilities into realities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: It is + adj. + that 从句；turn A into B“把 A 变成 B”，与 impossibilities 对应用复数 realities。

q63.sampleAnswer: While looking at the photo, he recalled his happy childhood.
references: While looking at the photo, he recalled his happy childhood.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: recall“回想起”，用一般过去时；while doing 表示“在……的时候”。

q64.sampleAnswer: We received several answers, and picked one at random.
references: We received several answers, and picked one at random.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: at random“随机地”，放在句末修饰 picked。

q65.sampleAnswer: These college volunteers are active in all fields, ranging from environmental protection and health care to public welfare education, which shows us what youth is supposed to be.
references: These college volunteers are active in all fields, ranging from environmental protection and health care to public welfare education, which shows us what youth is supposed to be.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: ranging from A to B“从 A 到 B 不等”作状语列举范围；which 引导非限制性定语从句。

q66.sampleAnswer: The rapid development of science has made the planet where we live become smaller.
references: The rapid development of science has made the planet where we live become smaller.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: the rapid development of“……的迅速发展”；make sth. do“使……变得”；where 引导定语从句。

q67.sampleAnswer: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.
references: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: by the end of last month 与过去完成时 had received 连用；created by 是过去分词作后置定语。

q68.sampleAnswer: What really matters for students is to form good habits while gaining knowledge.
references: What really matters for students is to form good habits while gaining knowledge.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: What 引导主语从句，really 修饰 matters“真正重要”；不定式作表语。

q69.sampleAnswer: The reason why the supply of vegetables falls short of the demand is that there is a lack of rain this summer.
references: The reason why the supply of vegetables falls short of the demand is that there is a lack of rain this summer.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: The reason why ... is that ...“……的原因是……”；fall short of the demand“供不应求”。

q70.sampleAnswer: Reach out your hands in aid of those who are in trouble and you’ll find your life more meaningful.
references: Reach out your hands in aid of those who are in trouble and you’ll find your life more meaningful.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “祈使句 + and + 将来时”表示条件和结果；reach out“伸出”。
